newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB sees scope in asset management.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB sees scope in asset management.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Group Plc sees scope for growth in asset management operations but will not pay the large premiums necessary to buy an asset management company at present, Lloyds TSB chief executive Peter Ellwood said on Tuesday.

Lloyds TSB, which has a total of 60 billion stg under management in its various operations, currently concentrates on managing the funds deposited in the products that it sells as well as in private banking.
"It's a nice business, it makes a nice profit," Ellwood said in an interview. "Will it grow? Yes it will. Are we on the acquisition trail for an asset management company? No we're not."
